^ How it works
# Read-through cache
Check the cache first, fall back to the database.
- One lookup on a hit
- Cached for five minutes
- Same API for callers
```ts
async function getUser(id: string) {
  const hit = await redis.get("user:" + id);
  if (hit) return JSON.parse(hit);
  const user = await db.user.find(id);
  await redis.set("user:" + id, JSON.stringify(user), "EX", 300);
  return user;
}
```

^ Postmortem · INC-142
# Checkout latency spike
Blameless review · 42 minutes of degraded service

---

## Impact

:::stats style=big
- 42m | Degraded
- 18% | Checkouts slowed
- 0 | Data lost
:::

---

## Timeline

:::timeline style=v
- 09:12 | p99 latency alert fires
- 09:20 | Rollback of release 5.3.1
- 09:34 | Cache warmed, latency normal
- 09:54 | Incident closed
:::

---

## Root cause

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Release 5.3.1] --> B[Cache key change]
  B --> C[Cold cache]
  C --> D[DB overload]
```

---

## Follow-ups

- [ ] Canary cache hit-rate before full rollout
- [ ] Alert on cache miss ratio, not just latency
- [ ] Runbook: warm cache after key changes

templates.name: Tech talk
templates.description: A conference or meetup talk: the problem, a code walkthrough, an architecture diagram and takeaways.
templates.author: Moovendhan V
templates.md:
---
speaker: Your Name
event: DevConf
---
<!-- layout: center -->
^ ${event}
# Caching without tears
How we cut API latency by 70%. ${speaker}

---

## The problem

:::stats style=big
- 900 ms | p99 latency
- 40% | Requests that hit the DB twice
:::

Note: Ask the room who has seen numbers like this.

---

## The architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  C[Client] --> A[API]
  A --> R[(Redis)]
  A --> D[(Postgres)]
  R -. miss .-> D
```

---

## Read-through cache

```ts cache.ts {1|2-3|4-6}
export async function getUser(id: string) {
  const hit = await redis.get("user:" + id);
  if (hit) return JSON.parse(hit);
  const user = await db.user.find(id);
  await redis.set("user:" + id, JSON.stringify(user), "EX", 300);
  return user;
}
```

Note: Step through: lookup, hit path, then miss path and write-back.

---

## Gotchas

> [!WARNING] Invalidate on write, or users will see stale data for up to 5 minutes.

- Stampedes when a hot key expires
- Cache keys that change between releases
- Caching errors by accident

---

## Results

:::chart style=column ms
- Before | 900
- Week 1 | 420
- Week 4 | 270
:::

---

## Takeaways

:::cards style=numbered cols=3
- check | Measure first | Find the hot paths
- check | Cache reads | Invalidate on writes
- check | Watch hit rate | Alert when it drops
:::

---
